name: partner-team-fleet-connection
executionConcern: Partner Store-team/fleet lifecycle plus canonical migration-evidence integrity
objective: Make Partner team and courier connection lifecycle use one DSH Store-scoped, versioned, idempotent and audited truth and correct stale Partner Fleet Product Truth migration evidence without rewriting applied history.
truthOwner: DSH Store-team/Partner-fleet domains own membership and lifecycle; Product Truth owns current evidence declarations; Identity authenticates actors only.

tasks.objective: Repair stale Partner Fleet canonical migration evidence and prove migration authority
tasks.currentProblem: PARTNER_FLEET_CONNECTION Product Truth still references removed dsh-933_jrn030_partner_fleet_action_audit.sql while the live migration is dsh-933_partner_fleet_action_audit.sql.
tasks.requiredChange: Update the canonical Product Truth evidence reference to the live migration, verify migration manifest/amendment integrity, and remove the stale current-evidence pointer. Do not rename/rewrite an applied migration or mutate historical checksums to make stale metadata fit.
tasks.targetState: Every current Partner Fleet evidence reference resolves to a real governed artifact and migration history remains immutable/valid.
tasks.action: Correct only the Product Truth evidence metadata; run path-existence/governance/database checks; if other fleet evidence names are stale, reconcile them through current authority rather than destructive migration edits.
mustNotChange: Do not rename/rewrite an applied migration to match stale documentation.
Do not treat planning text as authority over migration manifest/current Product Truth.
acceptanceCriteria: Old jrn030 migration reference is absent from current Partner Fleet Product Truth.
Live dsh-933_partner_fleet_action_audit.sql exists and is the declared current evidence.
tasks.rollback: Revert only the Product Truth metadata correction if necessary; never restore a dead current evidence path or alter migration history.
tasks.commitBoundary: A focused canonical-evidence cleanup may be committed with U004 fleet changes only when all related checks pass.

tasks.objective: Close Partner team/fleet membership lifecycle at DSH
tasks.currentProblem: Static team guards and route presence do not prove Store-team membership, one-time-code concurrency, expiry/revocation, versioning, audit, notifications and cross-surface readback cannot diverge.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace invitation/member actions and fleet issue/list/revoke/redeem/disconnect through DSH transactions, constraints, audit/notification and affected surfaces; repair every reproduced lifecycle/isolation defect and remove any parallel local membership truth.
tasks.targetState: One Store-scoped DSH membership lifecycle is authoritative, duplicate-safe, auditable and correctly redacted for Partner/Captain/operator consumers.
tasks.action: Run fleet backend/contract/database checks; exercise valid issue/redeem/disconnect plus expired/revoked/replayed/stale-version/duplicate/cross-Store/cross-Captain cases; correct DSH owner first; rerun all counterpart readbacks.
mustNotChange: Do not persist plaintext connection codes.
Do not create local fleet membership truth.
Do not let operator mutate through a read-only fleet view.
Do not broaden independent Captain/Workforce scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Partner issue/list/revoke and Captain redeem/list/disconnect are correctly actor/Store scoped.
Expired/revoked/replayed/duplicate/stale cases fail deterministically under concurrency.
Partner/Captain/operator readback converges with required redaction.
Lifecycle mutations are versioned, audited and notified where Product Truth requires.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused fleet owner changes while preserving secure membership/audit history; never restore a local parallel truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U004 lifecycle change set after positive/negative backend/database/contract/runtime checks pass.
